name: runvouch
description: Watchdog for unattended AI agents: agent health, alerts, run reports with evidence and cost.
long_description: Ask Claude which of your scheduled agents are healthy, read open alerts (missed runs, silent failures, retry storms, cost caps, drift), and report runs with evidence. Free for 3 agents at runvouch.com.
